speaker: alice
text: I want to talk through the export feature with you. Users keep asking for a CSV download.

speaker: alice
text: Where does the export code live right now?

speaker: alice
text: Okay, that is what I thought. The query runs in the request handler, so big exports time out.

speaker: alice
text: So the plan is to move it to a background job.

speaker: alice
text: Does the job queue we already have support retries?

speaker: alice
text: Good. I only want a retry for network errors, not for bad input.

speaker: alice
text: How would you tell those two apart in the worker?

speaker: alice
text: That makes sense. Let us keep the error classes in one small module.

speaker: alice
text: Can you list the tests we would need for that module?

speaker: alice
text: Fine, three tests is enough for a first version.

speaker: alice
text: Now the file itself. I would stream the rows instead of building the whole file in memory.

speaker: alice
text: Is there any reason not to stream it?

speaker: alice
text: Right. And the download link should expire after a day.

speaker: alice
text: What would you use to store the file until then?

speaker: alice
text: Local disk is fine for now, we can move to object storage later.

speaker: alice
text: One more thing. Someone asked me, and I quote, "is the export limited to admins?"

speaker: alice
text: For now yes, admins only. We can open it up after the first release.

speaker: alice
text: Let me think out loud for a moment about the column order.

speaker: alice
text: I think it should match the table on the screen. Do you agree?

speaker: alice
text: Good. Last question, how long do you think the whole thing will take (roughly)?

speaker: alice
text: That works for me. Thanks, this was useful.
